metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature in Palm Springs, California higher on July 15-21, 2017 than the 2001-2010 average for the same period?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Dataset candidates: MODIS LST (MOD11A1 Terra daily, MYD11A1 Aqua daily, MOD11A2 Terra 8-day, MYD11A2 Aqua 8-day).
- Location: Palm Springs, CA (Point [-116.5453, 33.8303]) buffered 10 km.
- Dates: 2017-07-15 to 2017-07-22; baseline 2001-2010 restricted to day-of-year 196–202 (Jul 15–21).

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Use QC_Day bits 0–1 <= 1 (good or other quality) and LST > 0; convert to Kelvin using scale factor 0.02.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If collection size is 0 for either period across all candidates -> C1.
- If valid pixel count after masking is 0 for either period -> C2.
- If means are null or outside 200–400 K -> C3.
- Else compare 2017 mean vs baseline mean to decide A/B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function getInfoAsync(eeObj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    eeObj.getInfo((res, err) => {
      if (err) reject(err);
      else resolve(res);
    });
  });
}

function processLSTImage(img) {
  // Mask using QC_Day bits 0-1 <= 1 (good or other quality) and nonzero LST
  const lst = img.select('LST_Day_1km');
  const qc = img.select('QC_Day');
  const qa01 = qc.bitwiseAnd(3); // bits 0-1
  const mask = qa01.lte(1).and(lst.neq(0));
  const lstK = lst.updateMask(mask).multiply(0.02).rename('LST_Day_1km');
  return lstK.copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']);
}

function makeCollection(datasetId, roi, start, end, doyStart, doyEnd) {
  let col = ee.ImageCollection(datasetId)
    .filterBounds(roi)
    .filterDate(start, end);
  if (doyStart !== null && doyEnd !== null) {
    col = col.filter(ee.Filter.dayOfYear(doyStart, doyEnd));
  }
  return col;
}

async function tryDataset(datasetId, roi, dates) {
  const col2017 = makeCollection(datasetId, roi, dates.y2017.start, dates.y2017.end, null, null);
  const colBase = makeCollection(datasetId, roi, dates.base.rangeStart, dates.base.rangeEnd, dates.base.doyStart, dates.base.doyEnd);

  const size2017 = await getInfoAsync(col2017.size());
  const sizeBase = await getInfoAsync(colBase.size());

  return { ok: (size2017 > 0 && sizeBase > 0), col2017, colBase, size2017, sizeBase };
}

async function statsForCollection(col, roi, scale) {
  const lstCol = col.map(processLSTImage);
  const meanImg = lstCol.mean();
  const meanDict = meanImg.reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}),
    geometry: roi,
    scale: scale,
    maxPixels: 1e9,
    bestEffort: true
  });
  const meanK = await getInfoAsync(meanDict.get('LST_Day_1km_mean'));
  const countValid = await getInfoAsync(meanDict.get('LST_Day_1km_count'));
  const totalPix = await getInfoAsync(ee.Image.constant(1).reduceRegion({
    reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry: roi,
    scale: scale,
    maxPixels: 1e9,
    bestEffort: true
  }).get('constant'));
  return { meanK, countValid: countValid || 0, totalPix: totalPix || 0 };
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-116.5453, 33.8303]);
    const roi = point.buffer(10000); // 10 km
    const scale = 1000;

    const dates = {
      y2017: { start: '2017-07-15', end: '2017-07-22' }, // end exclusive
      base: {
        rangeStart: '2001-01-01',
        rangeEnd: '2010-12-31',
        doyStart: 196, // Jul 15
        doyEnd: 202    // Jul 21
      }
    };

    const candidates = [
      { id: 'MODIS/061/MOD11A1', label: 'MOD11A1 Terra Daily' },
      { id: 'MODIS/061/MYD11A1', label: 'MYD11A1 Aqua Daily' },
      { id: 'MODIS/061/MOD11A2', label: 'MOD11A2 Terra 8-day' },
      { id: 'MODIS/061/MYD11A2', label: 'MYD11A2 Aqua 8-day' }
    ];

    let chosen = null;
    for (const c of candidates) {
      const trial = await tryDataset(c.id, roi, dates);
      if (trial.ok) {
        chosen = { ...trial, datasetId: c.id, datasetLabel: c.label };
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!chosen) {
      console.log('No images found for one or both periods after trying MODIS Terra/Aqua daily and 8-day.');
      console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location for one or both comparison points).');
      return;
    }

    // 2. Processing & Validation
    const roiPix = await getInfoAsync(ee.Image.constant(1).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: scale,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true
    }).get('constant'));

    const s2017 = await statsForCollection(chosen.col2017, roi, scale);
    const sBase = await statsForCollection(chosen.colBase, roi, scale);

    console.log(`Dataset: ${chosen.datasetLabel}`);
    console.log(`ROI ~10km buffer pixels @1km: ${roiPix}`);

    const size2017 = chosen.size2017;
    const sizeBase = chosen.sizeBase;

    const validPct2017 = s2017.totalPix > 0 ? (100.0 * s2017.countValid / s2017.totalPix) : 0;
    const validPctBase = sBase.totalPix > 0 ? (100.0 * sBase.countValid / sBase.totalPix) : 0;

    console.log(`2017 Jul15-21 Images: ${size2017}, Valid px: ${s2017.countValid}/${s2017.totalPix} (${validPct2017.toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log(`2001-2010 Jul15-21 Images: ${sizeBase}, Valid px: ${sBase.countValid}/${sBase.totalPix} (${validPctBase.toFixed(1)}%)`);

    if (s2017.countValid === 0 || sBase.countValid === 0) {
      console.log('No valid pixels after QC masking for one or both periods.');
      console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels (Images exist, but after cloud masking/processing, 0 pixels remain).');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Means and sanity checks
    const mean2017K = s2017.meanK;
    const meanBaseK = sBase.meanK;

    if (mean2017K === null || meanBaseK === null || isNaN(mean2017K) || isNaN(meanBaseK)
        || mean2017K < 200 || mean2017K > 400 || meanBaseK < 200 || meanBaseK > 400) {
      console.log(`Invalid means K -> 2017: ${mean2017K}, Base: ${meanBaseK}`);
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure (Result is `None`, `NaN`, or invalid).');
      return;
    }

    const mean2017C = mean2017K - 273.15;
    const meanBaseC = meanBaseK - 273.15;
    const diffC = mean2017C - meanBaseC;

    console.log(`2017 Mean LST: ${mean2017C.toFixed(2)} °C (${mean2017K.toFixed(2)} K)`);
    console.log(`2001-2010 Mean LST: ${meanBaseC.toFixed(2)} °C (${meanBaseK.toFixed(2)} K)`);
    console.log(`Difference (2017 - baseline): ${diffC.toFixed(2)} °C`);

    // 4. Final Answer
    const higher = diffC > 0;
    console.log(higher ? 'A: Yes' : 'B: No');

  } catch (e) {
    console.log(`Error: ${e && e.message ? e.message : e}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
